critical_code_review_comments: Lazy-import design is clean: MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mplconfig scoped inside render_map_png prevents home-dir writes on read-only pods; matplotlib fontManager cache built once (first PDF request) and reused. First evidence.pdf call may take ~10s for cold matplotlib import (font_manager scan visible in logs from 16:37:00 range), so the k8s health probe now correctly decouples from this via /health returning before startup task completes.

app.state.ready flag pattern with background _startup_tasks is the standard FastAPI lifespan solution - readiness never blocks liveness. Consider distinguishing /health (liveness) from a separate /ready (readiness) probe in k8s manifests so pods aren't marked ready until seeders complete; currently both return 200 regardless of ready:true/false which is fine for liveness but sub-optimal for rolling deploys.
cv2 LazyModule proxy in lazy_libs.py wired into detector.py and dark_vessel.py works transparently (dark_count=13 on POST scan). No import errors observed in reload cycle logs.

Minor: existing tests/test_iteration15.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var explicitly (KeyError otherwise). Recommend a conftest fallback that reads /app/frontend/.env for smoother CI. Not a bug.

rca_of_the_issue: Original prod issue: uvicorn startup blocked on matplotlib font_manager scan (~20s) + heavy seeders, causing k8s liveness probe (usually 3s timeout, 3 retries) to see connection refused and restart the pod repeatedly. Fix verified: (a) heavy libs (matplotlib, cv2, global_land_mask) moved out of module-scope into function-scope with MPLCONFIGDIR redirect; (b) lifespan spawns _startup_tasks as asyncio.create_task so uvicorn 'application startup complete' fires immediately; (c) /health and /api/health return 200 unconditionally with ready flag reflecting startup task completion. Empirical restart shows port 8001 answering 200 within 500ms and ready:true within 1s. No traceback in backend.err.log post-restart.
